name: High-Risk (PvP) spellbook text states the aura's 20% experience bonus, not 15% (#9333)
contract: High-Risk (PvP) 84421 is the spellbook spell that selects High-Risk. Its Spell.dbc description states
a literal 'grants 15% increased experience', while the High-Risk aura 1004019 it applies carries
SPELL_AURA_MOD_XP_PCT with EffectBasePoints 19 and EffectDieSides 1, a 20% bonus, and its buff text
reads $s1%. The fix streams the unchanged DBC description through coa_client_spell_description
(SMSG_PATCH_SPELL, opcode 2346, at login) with the number read from $1004019s1, so the spellbook
and the buff quote the same DBC value. Row 500639 (Runeshroud, published by the same table) is the
control for the stream. Rendered client text is outside the harness.

steps.label: The existing description stream is captured
DISCRIMINATING: the text reads the aura's experience bonus
The native description is kept
steps.text: Can only be cast while in a rested area!

steps.label: The High-Risk aura applies the 20% experience bonus the text now quotes
